scripts.build:native: cargo build --manifest-path ./native/Cargo.toml && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const platform=process.platform;const sourceName=platform==='win32'?'calamine_js_native.dll':platform==='darwin'?'libcalamine_js_native.dylib':'libcalamine_js_native.so';const source=path.join(process.cwd(),'native','target','debug',sourceName);const distDir=path.join(process.cwd(),'dist');fs.mkdirSync(distDir,{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(source,path.join(distDir,'calamine_js_native.node'));"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:native && pnpm run build:ts
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:native && pnpm run test:js
